product.title: Private Houston Tour 3-hr Air-Conditioned City Tour, customizable

description.text: Explore Houston on a customizable three-hour private city tour in an air-conditioned vehicle with hotel pickup from central locations. The route commonly includes Market Square, Buffalo Bayou Park, the Museum District, River Oaks, and Discovery Green with time for murals and neighborhood stories. Stops include Market Square, Buffalo Bayou Park, Houston Museum District, River Oaks, Discovery Green. Local commentary and route logistics are handled so you can focus on Houston skyline views, bayou corridors, and neighborhood landmarks. Ideal for visitors basing in Houston who want a guided Space City experience without coordinating meeting points or attraction entrances on their own.
